sourceTitle: Little By Little; or, The Cruise of the Flyaway
description: "Little By Little; or, The Cruise of the Flyaway" by William Taylor Adams (Oliver Optic) is a novel written in the mid-19th century. The story follows Paul Duncan, a young boy who embarks on nautical adventures while learning crucial life lessons about responsibility and independence.
